name: com.alittlebb.statemachine
description: State machine module: ScriptableObject state ids, Enter/Exit states, Switch and Push/Pop transitions with listener signals.

samples.description: One scene with a MainMenu and a Gameplay state (Switch) and a Pause popup pushed on top of Gameplay (Push / Pop). StateListener components show and hide the UI panels; the sample has no script. Needs Unity UI (com.unity.ugui) and the Input System (com.unity.inputsystem).
